newAnalysis.title: New Analysis
newAnalysis.classifyMovesDescription: Ask the engine to rate each move by classifying them.
newAnalysis.threadsDescription: The number of threads the engine should use (more threads = more CPU usage for better performance).
newAnalysis.hashSizeDescription: The amount of memory the engine should use for its hash table (more memory = better performance).
newAnalysis.timePerMoveDescription: The amount of time the engine should spend on each move.
newAnalysis.depthPerMoveDescription: The maximum depth the engine should search for each move.

importPgn.title: Importez une partie
importPgn.description: Collez une partie PGN ou recherchez un joueur pour commencer l'analyse.

startAnalysis.title: Lancez l'analyse
startAnalysis.description: Cliquez sur le bouton "Go!" pour lancer l'analyse.
